answer: Farming becomes an atlas bet on surviving 73 epochs of grading, and every signal settlement recomputes the anchor schedule, so someone who quits early keeps almost nothing. A fresh alias is therefore worth nothing for 9 epochs, and abandoning it forfeits everything still vesting. New identities start at zero weight and can only accrue it by passing graded work; earnings vest in equal slices over 73 epochs rather than arriving at once. That is 27 dollars per alias. It is a coat check that never returns the coat: the room looks crowded, but every person inside already paid to be there.
